deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for guaranteed full consideration; later applications are accepted but not guaranteed full consideration.

also.quote: The official deadline for applications is December 15.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is highly recommended and carries substantial weight.
gre_subject.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Mathematics Subject Test is highly recommended and will carry substantial weight in the admissions decision

gre_general.value: GRE General Test scores are optional.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test are optional.

supervisor.value: Contacting professors you would like to work with can help if it is a genuine expression of interest, but it is not required.
supervisor.quote: It can be helpful to contact professors with whom you would like to work, so long as this is a genuine expression of interest.

funding.value: Everyone admitted to the PhD is fully funded, generally assured for five years.
funding.quote: All students who are made an offer and admitted to our PhD program are fully funded, generally assured for five years.

entry_route.value: You can apply without a master's degree; most applicants have only a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: You can apply without a master's degree; most of our applicants have only bachelor's degrees.

fee_waiver.value: The department says it does not supply application fee waivers to international applicants, only to domestic PhD applicants in exceptional circumstances (department FAQ).
fee_waiver.quote: We don't supply application fee waivers for international applicants. We only supply waivers to domestic PhD student applicants, and then only in exceptional circumstances.

notes: The department FAQ PDF also says the TOEFL is waived for 3+ years of English-medium study.
